notes: Strategy Lab arrives - your algo-trading idea, v1, free and entirely on your phone. Pick a template (EMA crossover, Supertrend follow, RSI reversal, opening-range breakout), set lots and SL/target, and BACKTEST it on real candles with real costs charged - the result tells you plainly when a rule did not clear costs, because most do not. Flip Deploy and it trades PAPER money through the same engine your own orders use, tagged with a lightning bolt, acting only on closed 1-minute candles during market hours. Five tests pin its honesty: entries fill at the next bar open, a bar that touches both stop and target resolves as the stop, and costs are always charged.
